# BSM Holdings

> BSM Holdings provides residential property management across Oklahoma, with clear owner reporting and direct resident support.

BSM Holdings manages single-family homes, duplexes, triplexes, townhomes, and apartments across the Oklahoma City metro and select properties in the Tulsa metro.

- Contact: ty@bsmholdings.com
- Service area: Oklahoma City metro and select Tulsa properties

## Services

- **Property management** — leasing administration, resident support, maintenance coordination, and day-to-day operations.
- **Properties** — browse the communities and homes managed by BSM Holdings.
- **Technology** — operating systems, reporting, and integrations built around property operations.

## Brand and naming

- The company name is **BSM Holdings**.
- BSM Holdings is a residential property management company serving Oklahoma.
- Resident Login links directly to the external resident portal.
